The issuer shows solid liquidity (current ratio ~2.2) and healthy profitability (net margin ~10% and EBIT margin ~17%). However, the capital structure is moderately levered (liabilities ~67% of assets) and retained earnings are negative (-$1,086M), indicating accumulated losses that constrain balance-sheet strength. Overall, credit quality appears around the lower end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB-
